about_the_game:
Surrounded by a dark void with no way of escape, a small village is all that's left, stranded.
Explore the surroundings of the beautiful but strange village, uncovering the mysteries of the Black Sea, all the while fighting monsters and bosses in your way.



Encounter unique monsters
Fight off peculiar monsters of the surrounding environment.

Expand your map
While the village is small, it is still easy to get lost. Find landmarks to expand your map.

Explore through different environments
Seasons change over time, and new areas are traversable as the story progresses.

Interact with NPC's
Upgrade your equipment, or learn more about them.

short_description: No Name Village is a top-down adventure game, set in a peaceful village that is at risk of being swallowed by the Black Sea. Follow our boy protagonist as he explores, fight off monsters, and uncovers the situation of the world around him.
